translation.name: Kazuwamgbani ka savu n Tsikimba n aɓon a ɗa a ɗanga̱sai a kazuwamgbani ka cau

content: Uwenishike ubana a asu u nkoshi
Gogo‑na nkoshi ma Atoni n ɗa ma dansa̱ka. Mpa dem makoshi ma kpam n wene ta̱ upana u ikyamba u Kirisiti Kawauwi. Ma tono yi ta̱ a tsupige tsu ne n karinga̱ ka ne u gono baci.

Tyoku ɗa aliniki a tsu kirana na̱ ncon n le, nala dem u gain i kirana n gba̱ ko ya baci Kashila̱ ka zuwai a akere a ɗe. I yain u ɗa n uciga u ɗe, kotsu i yain tsali an ya yan u ɗa wa. I yain nala an ya pana kayanyan ka ugbashika Kashila̱. Kotsu i yain nala n i zuwi uma a ili i likimba iꞌya ya tuwa̱ ɗa̱ wa.
Kotsu i gonuko kaci ka ɗe azapige hal n i ɓarana̱si ama kaberikete wa, shegai i gonuko kaci ka ɗe i woko iryoci i shinga.
Nala kpam, Magono ma Aliniki ma tuwa̱ baci, wa na̱ka̱ ɗa̱ ta̱ funi u tsupige u ɗa bawu wa kporo.
Uwenishike ubana a asu u alobo

Eɗa̱ alobo, panai karinga̱ ka nkoshi. Gba̱ ɗe kpam she i ɓa̱nga̱mgba̱na̱ yavu agbashi a ɗa a vakunki kaci ka le, kpaci “Kashila̱ ka ꞌyuwan ta̱ aza ɗa aꞌa̱ri n ara̱ɗi, u na̱ka̱i kpam ukuna u shinga u ne a asu u aza ɗa a vakunki kaci ka le.”
Adama a nala, i vakunku kaci ka ɗe a ucira u Kashila̱. Aꞌayin a ɗa baci aꞌayin a ne a tuwa̱i, wa ra̱ɗa̱gba̱ ɗa̱ ta̱ a zuba.
Tsunki Kashila̱ gba̱ ili iꞌya ya ɓa̱la̱ ɗa̱, kpaci wa kirana ta̱ n a̱ɗa̱.
Kain dem i rongo a uwundya n afoɓi. Kala̱pa̱nsi ka utokulalu u ɗe, kpam aya pini wa genge tyoku u gabako wa bolo uza ɗa wa ka̱na̱ tsa̱ra̱ u takuma.
Shamgbai n ucira a ili iꞌya i wushuki n iꞌya, nala ya yan i lyai kaci ka ne n ucira. U gan ta̱ i reve, gba̱ Atoni a Asheku ko nte wa a likimba a ka pana ta̱ icun i upana u ikyamba u na vi.

Aꞌayin a ɗa baci i panai ikyamba kenu, Kashila̱ ka kirana ta̱ n a̱ɗa̱, kpam u zuwa atakasuvu a ɗe a gbama, wa zuwa ɗa̱ ta̱ kpam i shamgba n ucira. Yan ɗa Kashila̱ ka tsu yan nala adama a ɗa wa̱ri uza u shinga aꞌayin dem. U zuwa ɗa̱ ta̱ i tsa̱ra̱ tsupige tsu ne bawu utyoku a asu u ɗa u ɓolomgbono ɗa̱ n Kawauwi.
Kashila̱ ka lya ta̱ tsugono tsu ko ndya wa hal ubana bawu utyoku. Ami.

Ma wundya ta̱ Sila tyoku u utoku kpam uza ɗa n wushuki n eyi. U ɓa̱nga̱ mu ta̱ a asu u ukorongu maku ma ukanikorongi u na vi. Ili iꞌya i zuwai n korongi u ɗa iꞌya, tsa̱ra̱ n gbamatangu ɗa̱, kpam n tonuko ɗa̱ tyoku ɗa Kashila̱ ka̱ri uza u shinga, adama a ɗa kain dem i rongo uwushukusu n eyi.
a ka sukunku ɗa̱ ta̱ idyani. Kashila̱ ka ɗanga̱sa le ta̱ dem tyoku ɗa u ɗanga̱sa ɗa̱. Maku ma va̱ dem Marku wa dana̱sa ɗa̱ ta̱.
Damamgbanai a asuvu a uciga u Atoni. Kavasu ka va̱ ka Kashila̱ ka na̱ka̱ ɗa̱ ndishi n shinga, eɗa̱ aza ɗa iꞌa̱ri aza a Kirisiti Kawauwi.

footnotes.text: Arevi a Tagara̱da u Kashila̱ a wushuku ta̱ an Bituru yankai “Babila” manyan tsa̱ra̱ u yain kadyanshi a kaci ka ilyuci i Roma.
